pack.name: Guardians of the Ice Barrier
pack.blurb: The Ice Barrier: WATER monsters who lock the field while another of them stands guard, and the Synchro dragons Brionac, Gungnir and Trishula they become.

deck.name: Guardians of the Ice Barrier
deck.cover: Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
deck.blurb: Two Ice Barrier monsters on the field and the locks start: no big attackers, no Spells, no changing positions. Then a Tuner joins in and Trishula takes a card from everywhere.

npc.intro: Cold out tonight. It gets colder.
